# Forged Armor
Forged armor is specialized against burning fuel, not energy weapons. A laser still deals ordinary heat damage and bypasses the outfit's flame-only protection. Do not rely on a furnace suit to win a firefight against laser users.
## Furnace suits
The Forged and Forge Keeper furnace suits provide 95% flame-only reduction against flamer and incinerator projectile heat, burning, and floor fire. This is a combined-outfit limit: a mask or helmet cannot raise that flame-only reduction above 95%. Ordinary damage protection can still affect the remaining damage. You are highly resistant, not invulnerable.
Incinerator explosions have separate, strong protection. Other explosions use the suit's ordinary explosion resistance.
The Forged suit has 35% blunt, slash and piercing protection, 30% radiation protection, 20% caustic protection and 20% explosion resistance. It slows walking and running by 15%.
The Forge Keeper suit has 45% blunt, slash and piercing protection, 30% radiation protection, 20% caustic protection and 30% explosion resistance. It slows walking and running by 20%.
Matching player furnace helmets have reduced conventional protection. The suits and helmets give no ordinary heat armor; the standard gloves and boots can still provide a little heat protection. The Forged gas mask protects against atmospheric hazards and flames, rather than lasers. Conventional armor pieces still combine when worn.
## Tempered
The Tempered reinforced firefighter suit provides 90% flame-only reduction, capped at 90% across the outfit. It has separate incinerator-blast resistance and keeps its existing non-heat armor ratings and 10% running slowdown. Its suit and hood do not provide ordinary laser-heat protection.
Armor protection details list Fire separately from Heat. Fire covers burning fuel and marked flame projectiles; Heat covers ordinary heat damage, including lasers.
## Limits
These defenses do not prevent every injury, remove fire, extinguish burning fuel, or make dangerous environments safe to breathe. Laser fire and other attacks remain a threat.
